{
  "admissible_variables": [
    "calendar",
    "cost_ratio",
    "current_load",
    "horizon",
    "lagged_load",
    "load_statistics",
    "observed_weather",
    "recent_ramp",
    "region_id"
  ],
  "audit_log": {
    "human_approval_required": true,
    "triggered_rules": []
  },
  "decision": "accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",
    "numerical_workflow_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an auditable upward reserve-sizing study for ISO-NE with a 180-minute horizon and shortfall cost 10.0. Only decision-time admissible variables are permitted; future information, test-residual leakage, raw-data modification, fabricated results, and approval bypasses are forbidden. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "All requested fields are supported: region ISNE is allowed, horizon 180 minutes is allowed, cost_reserve=1.0 and cost_shortfall=10.0 are allowed, and the requested decision-time inputs map to admissible variables. The study requires human approval and uses the fixed rolling design.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "ISNE",
    "horizon_minutes": 180,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 10.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_costs",
    "enforce_decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "configure_rolling_window_train_730_cal_30_test_30_step_30",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "record_numerical_outputs_and_audit_log",
    "require_human_approval_before_use"
  ]
}
